title: New Website Redesign In Progress
summary: Our website is getting a full overhaul and will be ready within the next month!
content:
Our website is being rebuilt from scratch, and will be more polished, modern, and feature-rich and ever before! If you're reading this, you're reading it from that redesigned website itself. The website is being built for free by a member of our congregation, Daniel Stelljes, while the same people who edited the previous website can still just as easily make updates to the website. 

The new website will be ready in roughly 2-6 weeks.
